local_review.fix_note: Changed the spring-messaging dependency to use $libraryVersion, matching the target dependency and preserving cross-version reuse. Verified with ./gradlew compileTestJava -Pcoordinates=org.springframework:spring-websocket:6.2.10 --stacktrace and git diff --check. The repaired tree is approved.

The resulting tree is scoped to one library, uses only reachability-metadata.json metadata files, has library-specific tests in a separate package with no native-image skip or unverified Error catch, and reports a valid 0/0 dynamic-access case, so the coverage and metadata-count mismatch gates do not block. Local index gates were green, and the corrected test project compiles successfully.
